death_outcomes.configuration.title: Death Outcomes Configuration
death_outcomes.configuration.dropPlayerH: Whether players should drop their head upon death.
Only Drop When Killed By Player
Whether player heads should only drop if the death was caused directly or indirectly by another player.
Whether a player's head should only ever drop once per world. Once dropped, subsequent deaths will not drop their head.
death_outcomes.configuration.enablePlaye: Whether crafting a tracking compass by combining a compass and player head is enabled.
Whether placing a Player's Compass alone in a crafting grid dismantles and returns the player head back.
